svg.title: A running station: the supervisor that starts and stops hfnode on each operating system, what hfnode reads at start, the services it calls, its log and state directory, and the radio it drives over USB
svg.text: Who starts hfnode, what it reads and writes, what it drives, where its log goes
Supervisor: one of three, by operating system
runs as user hfnode, groups dialout, audio
stop: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after TimeoutStopSec=20
after any exit: ExecStopPost=-hfnode radio … rx
started by hfnode.command or the launchd plist
stop: passes SIGTERM on, SIGKILL after 20 s
keeps the Mac awake with caffeinate
task added by install-task.ps1; stop with Ctrl-C
closing the window skips the receive steps
give up after 3 starts in an hour
tx-inhibited; if the port will not
or Ctrl-C; on Windows also Ctrl-Break
exit status after a stop signal:
lists the serial ports and sound
inputs to put in the config; marks
the IC-7300, its codec, the keyer box
